part.text:
Fixed. The race was in `tsdb/head_append.go`: `AppendHistogram`/`AppendHistogramCTZeroSample` wrote `s.lastHistogramValue`/`s.lastFloatHistogramValue` on newly created series **without holding the series lock**, racing with `Commit()` → `memSeries.appendHistogram()` (tsdb/head_append.go:1512).

Changes:
- `getOrCreate` now returns `(s, created, err)` so the created flag is available at all call sites.
- The unprotected `lastHistogramValue`/`lastFloatHistogramValue` initialization was moved inside the `s.Lock()` block in `AppendHistogram` (integer and float cases) and `AppendHistogramCTZeroSample`, guarded by `created && s.lastHistogramValue == nil && s.lastFloatHistogramValue == nil`.
- Added the concurrency-safety TODO note to the stale-NaN handling in `Append`.

Validation: `go build ./tsdb` clean; the concurrency regression test passes under `-race`, and the broader tsdb append/head/OOO test suite passes (`go test ./tsdb/ -run "TestHead|TestAppender|TestAppend|TestCommit|TestWBL|TestOOO"`).
